supplemental_sources.summary: registryOptionsSchema is the single Registry limit schema used by the constructor and the host config. setGroupAccess to stopped/retired and revocation of the last group binding run #stopMembers, which sets every active member to stopped with operations '[]' and a bumped epoch in the same mutation. createBoundGroup runs in one transaction that checks the group_bind and group_member admin rights and then, through #mutateLocked with group_create, inserts the group, binds the connection and adds the member, so a missing right leaves nothing. withRelay goes through #relayTx: a withRelay called inside another's action runs in the enclosing transaction instead of opening one, so a guard and the operation it admits share one Registry lock. Omitted selection joins members to the agent table and counts only active ones. Rest of the Registry not re-read.

supplemental_sources.summary: provisionHostA2aIdentity converges the identity address (register product, enroll, bind the frozen urn:hab:host principal, setAccess to active ack/poll/status/submit) and throws a2a_identity_retired/conflict/revoked/stopped instead of repairing. hostRoute resolves the configured recipient and, through registry.withRelay, requires the caller to be someone other than the host identity and authorized to submit execution_request to that recipient; assertCurrent repeats this before enqueue, delivery, flush (before and after sendOnce(messageId)) and replies, and enqueue re-checks inside outbox.enqueueGuarded. The route builds its DurableSender with a guard that runs the host's service.submit inside registry.withRelay(caller context) after assertCurrent, so the caller check and the admission commit share one Registry transaction. The route's ownerId is the caller's agent ID, senderId the host identity, and replyWindowMs REPLY_WINDOW_MS. startHostA2a opens private outbox (max_records, status_retry_ms = REPLY_WINDOW_MS + ACK_RETRY_MS + 2h, both one day), inbox (max_records and max_body_bytes for 2 × max_records reply bodies, max_ack_records three times max_records, ack_retry_ms one day) and Task store files with HMAC keys derived from the fingerprint key, and a DurableReceiver whose poll passes on only an execution_accepted or execution_result replying to a host outbox record from that record's recipient while Date.now() < record expires_at + REPLY_WINDOW_MS; any other or later delivery is ACKed there with a fresh request ID and never reaches the inbox. Each receive cycle runs up to 16 receiveOnce per poll_interval_ms, then applyReplies: an inbox entry whose receipt is unconfirmed is never applied and is passed to mail.releaseUnconfirmable, which releases it only once no ACK can confirm it; for each receipt-confirmed entry it finds the Task by its in_reply_to source message ID (store.findBySource), applies the one reply through gateway.apply with a stored-Task route (same replyWindowMs) that cannot enqueue or flush, and releases the body; a RequestMalformedError or ZodError (a refused reply) also releases it, any other error keeps it for the next cycle, and an entry with no Task is released. At most once a minute it runs box.maintain(100) and mail.maintain(100) and then closeWindows, which applies the stored-Task route with no replies to up to 100 store.overdue(now - REPLY_WINDOW_MS) Tasks, each in its own try so one failing Task holds back neither the others nor maintenance. There is no background submit. The listener is 127.0.0.1 only, answers 503 while stopping, and close() waits for in-flight requests and the current cycle before closing the stores.

supplemental_sources.read_coverage: 1-165,374-650,675-770; capacity check at 320-345 after efa2435; total-row and legacy-ID bounds after 599c1f2; per-message ACK history and releaseUnconfirmable after 530cbfd
supplemental_sources.summary: Inline SQL schema/migration (schema 4 drops the schema-3 attachment columns and trigger), private file/owner options, transaction, body+stable ACK insertion, HMAC-checked withEntry, raw inbox listing and explicit release. A new message is refused with inbox_capacity_exceeded when the distinct (sender_id, message_id) pairs in the ACK records reach max_ack_records, when unreleased rows (released_at IS NULL) reach max_records or their body bytes would exceed max_body_bytes, or when all rows reach max_records + max_ack_records; a new generation of a message already in the ACK records takes no new history slot and is refused with inbox_capacity_exceeded once that message has max_attempts generations; a new non-replay-bound ID is refused with inbox_legacy_id_capacity_exceeded once non-replay-bound rows (relay_inbox_gc_safe = 0) reach max_ack_records. A released tombstone still matches an existing (sender_id, message_id). releaseUnconfirmable(senderId, messageId) expires stale ACK requests, then releases (empty body, released_at now, retain_until at least now + RECORD_RETENTION_MS) only an unreleased row with receipt_confirmed = 0, expires_at <= now and no pending ACK request, and returns whether one row changed. Other migration/GC sections not fully read.

supplemental_sources.summary: Read-only rollback listing. Opens the upgraded schema 4 journal copy, the backup journal, each --inbox copy and each --backup-inbox with node:sqlite readOnly, reads each --execution-record JSON export ({recipient_id, handled: [{sender_id, message_id}]}, refused if malformed), and prints no bodies. messages lists the union of every upgraded nats_messages row absent from the backup or staging/pending/leased/quarantined in it and every backup row still incomplete whose upgraded row is gone (final_state null), with backup_state, final_state and recipient_record (saved, absent or no_inbox_copy by the inbox's relay_inbox_meta agent_id). action is delivered for a final acked or a saved record; not_saved only for a final expired or quarantined row absent from its recipient's inbox copy before expires_at + RECORD_RETENTION_MS; otherwise unknown. restored_bodies lists each unreleased body of each backup inbox with upgraded_record (released, unreleased, absent or no_inbox_copy) and execution_record (handled, absent or no_record_copy); action is do_not_process when handled, process when absent from the execution record and still unreleased in the upgraded copy, otherwise unknown. restored_incomplete_expire_by is the latest expiry among backup rows still incomplete. The CLI accepts --upgraded-journal and --backup-journal once each and --inbox, --backup-inbox and --execution-record repeated.

supplemental_sources.read_coverage: diff from cddd9f4 (habHostAgentCard, link schema, reply handling, publicTask, enqueue/flush); diff from 599c1f2 (settle condition, apply); diff from 530cbfd (result window failure, per-step wait)
supplemental_sources.summary: habHostAgentCard describes completion as the recipient's result reply. The Task link stores a binding only when the route has an evidence port, and an optional failure "result_window_expired". With evidence, results still require verified closed engine evidence that matches the claimed state and result. Without it, execution_accepted gives WORKING and execution_result gives COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELED from the reply, recording reply_task_id; a different engine Task ID or a conflicting second terminal state is refused. Once the link has a failure, every later reply is skipped. publicTask adds attestation: "recipient_reply" when no binding is stored and reason from the link's failure. When a still non-terminal Task is observed with a route that names replyWindowMs at or after its source expires_at + replyWindowMs, it becomes TASK_STATE_FAILED with link.failure set and an agent status message `<task id>-result-window` whose text starts with result_window_expired and says the outcome is unknown, with metadata hab_relay.reason; before that, expiry with no reply stays INPUT_REQUIRED. SendMessage enqueues and flushes only the Task's own source message ID under the serial lock, then waits outside it: each 25 ms step takes the lock, reloads the stored Task (TaskNotFoundError if gone), asserts the route and observes it. After a save, an evidence route settles its matched replies only once the Task is terminal; a reply-attested route settles them after any save. apply(taskId, context, route) loads the stored Task and observes the route's replies under the handler's serial lock, outside any caller request. Rest of the handler not re-read.

supplemental_sources.maintenance: Added during A2A host maintenance after reading the diff from cddd9f4 (4d34aa1, 073c537, 6e4a1e9, e772a7c) as source evidence for HAB-A21, HAB-D20, HAB-E20 and HAB-C-E08. Runs in js-root (test/*.test.js) and test:a2a-relay. Cases: named-intent claim on a shared outbox; example a2a section validity; off by default; Task sent from the host identity and completed from the recipient's replies with attestation recipient_reply; restart survival; idempotent host-only provisioning and the refused urn:hab:host impostor; refusal of an operator-connected identity at start; 401 for unauthenticated and wrong-audience requests, refusal of unauthorized and cross-owner requests, quarantined forged replies, and loss of access after a revoked grant or disconnect. Review-fix maintenance: re-read the diff from efa2435 (c004e63..74c02b7); adds "after unrelated notices reach the cap, a valid reply is still saved and ACKed" and "a caller revoked from another connection between its check and the host submit never reaches the recipient", and asserts that an unrelated notice leaves no inbox record. Second review-fix maintenance: re-read the diff from 599c1f2 (to 2b764dd); adds "even when accepted replies fill the cap, the matching results are saved and ACKed and every Task completes", "Tasks that complete but are never read free their inbox slots, so new Tasks still complete after the outbox purge" and "a Task admitted once an outbox record is purged still gets its replies saved, even after a late reply" (evidence for HAB-D20 and HAB-E20). The last ACKs two replies sent two days after their request's expiry but does not read that Task's state. Third review-fix maintenance: re-read the diff from 530cbfd (to 4715b4e); adds "saved replies whose ACK can never be confirmed release their slots, so a later reply is still saved and completes its Task" (HAB-D20), "a blocking SendMessage completes from a result that arrives in a later receive cycle than its acceptance" (HAB-D20) and "a WORKING Task whose reply window closes without a result fails as result_window_expired, and a late result does not revive it" (HAB-E20, HAB-C-E09). The last ages the request two days while the host is stopped, waits for the stored Task to be TASK_STATE_FAILED without a caller read, asserts reason result_window_expired, an outcome-unknown status message and no Artifacts, and asserts that a late result is ACKed with no record and leaves the status unchanged.
